question: A team lead is setting up a new project that will be used for recurring quarterly business reviews. Which sequence of steps is correct?
options: A) Write the instructions; run a typical request; upload the reference documents; create the project and name its purpose.
B) Create the project and name its purpose; write the instructions; upload the reference documents; run a typical request.
C) Upload the reference documents; run a typical request; create the project and name its purpose; write the instructions.
D) Run a typical request; upload the reference documents; write the instructions; create the project and name its purpose.
correct_answers: B) Create the project and name its purpose; write the instructions; upload the reference documents; run a typical request.
explanations: The instructions and the test both precede the project they belong to.
Correct. Establish the workspace and its purpose, give it durable direction and background, then check it on real work.
Documents cannot be uploaded into a project that has not been created yet.
The setup is tested before any part of it exists.
